title: Add §6.1.3 parity interleaving to DVB-T2 bit interleaver
description:
## Goal

Add the missing parity-interleaving sub-stage of ETSI EN 302 755 v1.4.1 §6.1.3 to `DvbT2BitInterleaver` so that the bit interleaver matches the spec's full definition and validates bit-exact against the published ETSI reference vectors at TP07.

## Context (the bug)

87a2402f's `DvbT2BitInterleaver` implements only the column-twist sub-stage of §6.1.3. The spec text explicitly states (verbatim from `/data/specs/etsi/deliver/etsi_EN/302700_302799/302755/01.04.01_60/en_302755v010401p.txt:§6.1.3`):

> The output Λ of the LDPC encoder shall be bit interleaved, which consists of **parity interleaving** followed by **column twist interleaving**. The parity interleaver output is denoted by U and the column twist interleaver output by V.
>
> In the parity interleaving part, parity bits are interleaved by:
>
> ```
> u_i = λ_i for 0 ≤ i < K_ldpc                 (information bits not interleaved)
> u_{K_ldpc + 360t + s} = λ_{K_ldpc + Q_ldpc·s + t}  for 0 ≤ s < 360, 0 ≤ t < Q_ldpc
> ```

Q_ldpc = (N_ldpc − K_ldpc) / 360 is the LDPC code-specific quasi-cyclic parameter (per Table 7 of the spec / `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/params.rs`).

Empirical evidence (a7b1bb21 worker, session 2026-05-27): `bit_interleaver(TP06) ≠ TP07` for all tested in-scope ETSI vectors (~50% bit diff). The diff is fully explained by the missing parity interleaving — information bits stay in place but parity bits land in wrong positions.

## Deliverables

1. Extend `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/bit_interleaver.rs` so the public `interleave` / `deinterleave` / `deinterleave_llrs` methods apply parity interleaving BEFORE column twist (forward) and column-untwist BEFORE parity-deinterleave (inverse).

2. The parity interleaver:
   - Forward: `u_{K_ldpc + 360t + s} = λ_{K_ldpc + Q_ldpc·s + t}`
   - Inverse: solve for λ given u (it's a deterministic permutation of the parity region).
   - Information bits (`i < K_ldpc`) pass through unchanged.

3. Q_ldpc is per-(FrameSize, CodeRate); use the existing LDPC params from `params.rs` (look for `Qldpc` / `q_ldpc` / parity-block-shift fields, or compute as `(N_ldpc - K_ldpc) / 360`).

4. Empirical-verification integration test under `crates/gf2-coding/tests/` (or extend `tests/dvb_t2_chain_tp07a.rs` from `4cdaf1c5`):
   - For at least one ETSI vector per in-scope code-rate × modulation combination available locally (see `/data/specs/dvb/streams/`):
     a. Load TP06.
     b. Compute `interleaver.interleave(&tp06)` (with the fix).
     c. Assert it equals the ETSI reference TP07 (NOT TP07a — TP07 is after §6.1.3, before §6.1.4 cell-word demux).
   - Mark `#[ignore = "external: DVB-T2 ETSI vectors"]`.

## Success criteria

- [hard] `bit_interleaver.interleave(TP06) == TP07` bit-exact for at least 2 in-scope ETSI vectors (one 16-QAM, one 64-QAM; available candidates: VV007 16-QAM Rate2/3, VV009 64-QAM Rate2/3, VV014 64-QAM Rate3/4, VV020 16-QAM Rate1/2). Empirical verification against the actual vectors at `/data/specs/dvb/streams/`.
- [hard] Roundtrip identity still holds: `deinterleave(interleave(x)) == x` for random inputs across all 3 in-scope rates × QPSK/16-QAM/64-QAM × {Normal, Short}.
- [hard] All existing 87a2402f tests still pass (no regression).
- [hard] No new `unsafe`; satisfies `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.

## Non-goals

- §6.1.4 cell-word demux (separate task `a7b1bb21`).
- §6.1.5 cell interleaver.
- 256-QAM support (`DvbT2Modulation` enum stays at QPSK/16-QAM/64-QAM).
- API changes (interleave/deinterleave keep their `&self` signature and BitVec/Llr types).

## Verified modulation labels for in-scope ETSI vectors at `/data/specs/dvb/streams/`

(VERIFIED in this session 2026-05-27 against TP08 sample counts — earlier worker reports contained errors; use THIS table.)

| VV directory          | TP08 cells/block | bits/cell | Modulation | Code rate | In-scope? |
|-----------------------|------------------|-----------|------------|-----------|-----------|
| VV001-CR35_CSP        | 32400            | 2         | QPSK       | 3/5       | rate out of scope |
| VV003-CR23_CSP        | 32400            | 2         | QPSK       | 2/3       | rate in / mod out |
| VV009-4KFFT_CSP       | 10800            | 6         | 64-QAM     | 2/3       | **IN** |
| VV014-64QAM34_CSP     | 10800            | 6         | 64-QAM     | 3/4       | **IN** |

Other VV directories should be verified the same way (TP08 cells/block → modulation; TP05 length → rate). Trust the actual data, not VV directory names alone.

## Spec reference

ETSI EN 302 755 v1.4.1 §6.1.3 ("Bit Interleaver"), the parity-interleaving paragraph beginning "In the parity interleaving part, parity bits are interleaved by:".
